mechanism_narrative: EGFR+FGFR1 forced-proximity via flexible_GS8 linker (~40 Å) biases signaling toward MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways by enabling transphosphorylation-driven recruitment of GRB2, SHC1, FRS2, GAB1, and PIK3R1 adaptors, while sterically excluding PLCG1/PLCG2 which require a specific geometry that the EGFR-FGFR1 co-cluster cannot accommodate. The biased output upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) and downregulates aged-marker immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory/stress mediators (IL32, TXNIP, OTUD1), consistent with a rejuvenating transcriptional shift in aged skeletal muscle fibroblasts and MuSCs.
